prediction_masks: exported YOLOv8-seg polygons, rasterised with read_yolo_seg_masks (same reader as GT)
prompt_string: potholes. . pothole. . road pothole. . asphalt hole.
text_threshold_note: TEXT_THR is not passed to post-processing; boxes are filtered by BOX_THR only
pipeline_order: [road-band] -> box NMS -> drop empty SAM masks -> [mask NMS] -> [nested] -> [post-filters]
export: largest external contour only, approxPolyDP eps 1.5 px, contour area >= 10 px, coords clipped to [0,1]

evaluation.gt: YOLOv8-seg polygons, one polygon = one instance, filled to binary masks
evaluation.matching: greedy one-to-one by decreasing mask IoU; TP if IoU >= 0.5
evaluation.averaging: micro over all images; mean IoU/Dice over TP pairs only
evaluation.export_drop_rule: masks with no exported polygon are not predictions (not FP); unmatched GT stay FN
